title: The Lost Dog
description: Practise past tenses and linking words, then write a short story about a lost dog.
instructions: Do the exercises in Part 1. Then look at the story and write in Part 2.

exercises.prompt: Choose the correct word.
exercises.text: 🐶 Yesterday Nam ___ his dog in the park.
exercises.explanation: "Lose" is irregular. The past simple is "lost".

exercises.prompt: Write the correct form of the verb in brackets.
exercises.text: It was sunny and Nam ___ (walk) with Max.
exercises.explanation: Use "was/were + verb-ing" for an action in progress.

exercises.prompt: Put the words in the correct order to make a sentence.
exercises.explanation: Subject + past verb + after + noun: Max ran after a cat.

exercises.prompt: Choose the correct word.
exercises.text: While Nam was talking on the phone, Max ___ away.
exercises.explanation: A short action that interrupts a longer one uses the past simple: Max ran away.

exercises.prompt: There is one mistake in the sentence. Write the correct sentence.
exercises.text: Nam shouted "Max!" but the dog not came.
answers: Nam shouted "Max!" but the dog did not come.
Nam shouted "Max!" but the dog didn't come.
exercises.explanation: Use "did not + base verb" for a negative in the past: did not come.

exercises.prompt: Write a word: in, on, under, behind or next to.
exercises.text: 🌳 Nam looked ___ the big tree, but Max wasn't there.
exercises.explanation: Prepositions tell us where: behind the tree, under the tree.

exercises.prompt: Choose the correct word.
exercises.text: Nam asked a man ___ was selling ice cream.
exercises.explanation: Use "who" for people.

exercises.prompt: Put the words in the correct order to make a sentence.
answers: Did you see a small brown dog.
exercises.explanation: "Did" + subject + base verb makes a past question: Did you see a small brown dog?

exercises.prompt: Choose the correct word.
exercises.text: Nam was sad ___ he loved his dog very much.
exercises.explanation: "Because" gives a reason.

exercises.prompt: Complete the second sentence so that it means the same as the first. Use the word FASTER. Begin: "Nam ..."
exercises.text: The dog was not as fast as Nam.
answers: Nam was faster than the dog.
Nam was faster than the dog was.
exercises.explanation: "A is not as fast as B" means "B is faster than A".

exercises.prompt: Write the past simple of the verb in brackets.
exercises.text: 🔍 Nam and Linh ___ (look) for Max for an hour.
exercises.explanation: Regular verbs take -ed in the past simple: looked.

exercises.prompt: There is one mistake in the sentence. Write the correct sentence.
exercises.text: Then Linh sees a dog behind the school.
answers: Then Linh saw a dog behind the school.
exercises.explanation: The story is in the past, so use "saw" (the past of see).

exercises.prompt: Choose the correct word.
exercises.text: If we ___ him soon, his mum will be very worried.
exercises.explanation: After "if" in a first conditional we use the present simple: if we don't find.

exercises.prompt: Put the words in the correct order to make a sentence.
answers: He will be very happy to see you.
exercises.explanation: Subject + will + be + adjective: He will be very happy to see you.

exercises.prompt: Choose the correct word.
exercises.text: Linh said, "I have ___ Max's red ball in the grass!"
exercises.explanation: Present perfect = have + past participle. The past participle of find is found.

exercises.prompt: Write who, which or where.
exercises.text: They ran to the place ___ Linh saw the ball.
exercises.explanation: Use "where" for a place.

exercises.prompt: Choose the correct word.
exercises.text: The dog was so happy that he ___ not stop jumping.
exercises.explanation: "Could" is the past of "can". "He could not stop" = he was not able to stop.

exercises.prompt: Complete the second sentence so that it means the same as the first. Use the word HAS. Begin: "Nam ..."
exercises.text: Nam lost his dog and he found it again.
answers: Nam has found his dog again.
exercises.explanation: Use "has + past participle" when the result is important now: has found.

exercises.prompt: Write should or shouldn't.
exercises.text: You ___ keep your dog on a lead in the park.
exercises.explanation: "Should" gives advice: you should keep your dog on a lead.

exercises.prompt: There is one mistake in the sentence. Write the correct sentence.
exercises.text: Nam hugged Max and he gived him a big biscuit.
answers: Nam hugged Max and he gave him a big biscuit.
exercises.explanation: "Give" is irregular. The past simple is "gave".

task.prompt: Look at the story. Picture 1: Mai is playing with her puppy in the park. Picture 2: The puppy runs away after a ball. Picture 3: Mai is looking for the puppy. She is sad. Picture 4: A boy finds the puppy and brings it back. Write what happens.
contentPoints: Say where Mai and her puppy were.
Say what happened to the puppy.
task.modelAnswer: One sunny day, Mai was playing with her puppy in the park. Suddenly, the puppy ran after a ball and disappeared. Mai looked everywhere for him. She was very sad and she cried. Luckily, a kind boy found the puppy and brought him back. In the end, Mai was happy again and she said thank you to the boy.
